unit: one public task with two independent fresh arms
universe: all supplied public task metadata; no reference patch/hints inspected
exclude: any task ID present in parent-tracked textual files before this study; conservative metadata mentions count as exposed
ordering: ascending SHA256 of UTF8(s1-egv-v01-fresh-01: + instance_id), lexical ID tiebreak
replacement: none in same proposed study; stop if selected snapshot fails later baseline admission
order_rule: EGV first if lowest bit of SHA256(s1-egv-order-v01: + selected ID) is 1; otherwise Control first
timing: select only after CPU acceptance, before future task outcome/Issue inspection
